note: grdm-dev/elasticsearch8 (ADR-14): Elasticsearch 8.19.24 with analysis-kuromoji and analysis-icu, built in installer/images/elasticsearch8 on the official image (digest-pinned), running as uid 1000 with a read-only root: config/ is a tmpfs that grdm-entrypoint.sh fills (the official entrypoint writes the keystore holding the bootstrap password there), logs and /tmp are tmpfs, data and the TLS key live in the named volume elasticsearch8_data. Security is on: HTTP over TLS with a CA of the installation's own (made at first start, CA key discarded), the elastic superuser from ELASTIC8_PASSWORD, scripts disabled. Only the public CA certificate is copied to elasticsearch8_ca, which osf.io mounts read-only as its trust anchor. No port is published (ADR-02). The health check window is 30 s plus 120 tries of 10 s (about 20 minutes) because a start measured 8 min 10 s under full-system amd64 emulation (DEMO-22), where the former 12 tries (2.5 minutes) marked a healthy start unhealthy and `up` stopped with exit 40; a start that is up passes at once, and a broken one still fails inside the default `up` wait of 1800 s. The health check treats HTTP 401 on the TLS port as up: it proves the server answers over TLS with a certificate that chains to the CA while holding no credential; elasticsearch8_setup then waits for a yellow cluster with the credential.
